scope: blind full-workflow reconstruction: agent sees only the public clinical question; all published methods/results/criteria/design are excluded from its inputs
blindness: design_type_hint, pooled, living_or_update, criteria text and results are NOT inputs

agent.synthesis_route: bivariate/hierarchical summary ROC with sensitivity at a pre-specified specificity

criteria.population: persons presumed to have COVID-19, irrespective of age, symptom status or setting
criteria.index_test: commercial or pre-market point-of-care antigen-based rapid diagnostic tests (ag-RDT)
criteria.study_designs: comparative accuracy studies: prospective cohort, nested cohort, case-control or cross-sectional
criteria.meta_threshold: pool only when >= 4 studies provide complete 2x2 data for a test

exclusions.testing_purpose: testing for monitoring, quarantine decision or screening where the reference is not the diagnostic target
exclusions.small_samples: populations with fewer than 10 participants (verification ratio unstable)
exclusions.non_primary: studies that only re-analyse previously published data without new accuracy data

agent.minimal_decisive_question: Is this diagnostic_accuracy question answerable with the available node structure, or would pooling be misleading at alpha=0.1?

analysis_model.agent: bivariate/hierarchical summary ROC with sensitivity at a pre-specified specificity

population.agent: persons presumed to have COVID-19, irrespective of age, symptom status or setting
population.published: all study populations irrespective of age, presence of symptoms, or study location

index_test.agent: commercial or pre-market point-of-care antigen-based rapid diagnostic tests (ag-RDT)
index_test.published: Antigen rapid diagnostic test (ag-RDT) for SARS-CoV-2, developed for POC use (S1 Text)

study_designs.agent: comparative accuracy studies: prospective cohort, nested cohort, case-control or cross-sectional
study_designs.published: cohort studies, nested cohort studies, case-control or cross-sectional; including ≤4 studies without meta-analysis

meta_threshold.agent: pool only when >= 4 studies provide complete 2x2 data for a test
meta_threshold.published: meta-analysis only when ≥4 studies; otherwise narrative

monitoring_or_quarantine.published: patients tested for monitoring / ending quarantine
agent_facets: testing for monitoring, quarantine decision or screening where the reference is not the diagnostic target
populations with fewer than 10 participants (verification ratio unstable)

derivation.subgroup_aggregation: subgroup rows summed per study (59 studies with distinct subgroup 2x2; 3 duplicated rows taken once)
derivation.exclusion_rule: >=3 zero cells or undefined rates (amended pre-run; f104, f118, f189, f193)
derivation.metrics: raw 2x2 counts transcribed from the read-only reference workbook (CC BY-NC-ND; local staging only)

estimate_anchor.note: analysis-slice reconstruction agreement with the published review's pooled estimates; reports estimate-level similarity of the analysis stage on the same evidence corpus (the agent that ran the workflow could not have seen these estimates — see blind-reconstruction-agrdt.json)
